questions.q: Is Query Store enabled by default before SQL Server 2022?
options: No, it's off by default and must be enabled per database
Yes, it's on by default for every database on every version
It's an instance-wide setting, not per-database
It's only available in Azure SQL Database, never on-premises
questions.explain: Query Store is per-database and, on versions before SQL Server 2022, must be explicitly turned on with ALTER DATABASE ... SET QUERY_STORE = ON.

questions.q: What does setting Query Store's OPERATION_MODE to READ_WRITE actually do?
options: It's what actively captures new query and plan data going forward
It deletes all previously captured Query Store history
It disables Query Store entirely
It forces every query to use a single cached plan
questions.explain: READ_WRITE mode captures new data; READ_ONLY mode (often reached automatically after hitting MAX_STORAGE_SIZE_MB) stops recording but still allows querying history.

questions.q: What does sys.query_store_plan hold that sys.query_store_query does not?
options: One row per execution plan a query has used — a single query can have multiple plans over time
The literal SQL text of the query
Server-level login and permission information
Backup and restore history
questions.explain: sys.query_store_query has one row per distinct query; sys.query_store_plan tracks every plan that query has used, since a query can shift plans over time.

questions.q: Which catalog view holds the actual performance metrics (duration, CPU, logical reads) for a given plan?
options: sys.query_store_runtime_stats
sys.query_store_query
sys.query_store_plan
sys.database_files
questions.explain: sys.query_store_runtime_stats stores performance numbers per plan, per time interval, joined to sys.query_store_plan by plan_id.

questions.q: Why can Query Store answer 'did this query's performance change last week,' unlike the plan cache?
options: Query Store persists its data to disk, so it survives a SQL Server restart; the plan cache does not
Query Store only stores data for exactly seven days
The plan cache doesn't track performance metrics at all
Query Store and the plan cache store identical data, so there's no difference
questions.explain: Query Store writes to disk and persists across restarts, giving it real historical depth that the in-memory plan cache lacks.
